title: Backup
intro: A site backup is one zip with the site database, every user's library database and all original photos. It contains password hashes, so keep it as private as the data folder.
withThumbs: Include thumbnails (bigger archive; they can be regenerated)

restore.title: Restore
restore.help: A restore replaces all data on this server, so it runs with the API stopped. Stop mosaicWave, then run this on the host:
restore.check: Add --check to only validate the archive; nothing is changed.
restore.keep: Your current data is kept beside it as *.before-restore-<time> until you delete it.
